state.incomplete: Setup: incomplete — missing: {missing}. Run `/setup wizard` or set them under Settings.

setup.sessionExpired: This setup session expired (15 minutes of inactivity). Run `/setup wizard` again.
setup.notWizardOwner: Only the person who started /setup wizard can use these controls.
setup.cancelled: Setup cancelled. Nothing was changed. Run `/setup wizard` again anytime.

streamer.embedDescription: Here is what I set up. Anything marked ☑️ was already configured and I left it alone. Every setting below can still be changed whenever you like.
streamer.alreadyRunning: The streamer starter pack is already running for this server. Give it a moment and check the result.
streamer.genericFailure: something went wrong while setting this up. It has been logged. Run it again to retry.
streamer.unavailable: This feature is not available on this bot right now ({reason}).

twitch.title: Twitch go-live alerts
twitch.created: Watching **{login}**: a go-live alert will be posted in {channel}.
twitch.alreadyWatching: Already watching **{login}**, left as it is.
twitch.alreadyAny: This server already has {count} Twitch alert(s), left as they are.
twitch.noLogin: No Twitch login was given, so no alert was added yet. Add one with `/integration alerts add provider:twitch`, run `/setup streamer twitch_login:yourname`, or use Dashboard → Integrations.
twitch.invalidLogin: "{login}" is not a valid Twitch username (letters, numbers and underscores, up to 25 characters), so no alert was added.
twitch.noChannel: No channel to post **{login}**'s alerts in. Run this in a text channel or pass `alert_channel`.
twitch.unconfigured: Twitch alerts are not set up on this bot (no Twitch credentials), so no alert was added.
twitch.channelProblem: I can't fully post in {channel} yet (missing: {missing}). Give me those permissions there or the go-live alert won't appear.

stats.already: This server already has {count} stats channel(s), left as they are.

leveling.title: Leveling
leveling.enabled: Leveling is on with the default settings: members earn XP for chatting and for time in voice.

automod.title: Basic automod
automod.created: Added {count} rule(s): {names}. They only delete the message. Nobody is timed out or banned.
automod.keptExisting: Already had a rule for: {types}. Those were left as they are.
automod.already: Already had rules for: {types}, so I left them as they are.
automod.dryRunNote: The new automod rules start in **dry-run**: matches are logged and nothing is deleted yet. Check `/automod review`, then use `/automod rule dryrun` on each rule and `/automod dryrun off` when you're happy.

config.unknownKey: Unknown config key "{key}". Use the autocomplete suggestions to find a valid one.

permissions.hierarchyOk: ✅ My highest role outranks every configured staff role.
permissions.hierarchyWarning: ⚠️ My highest role is at or below <@&{roleId}> — I may not be able to moderate members with that role.
permissions.intentsOk: ✅ Every privileged intent needed by an enabled plugin is enabled.

permissions.administratorGranted: ⚠️ I have been granted **Administrator**, which is more than I need. Pavisie is designed to run on a least-privilege permission set — consider removing Administrator and re-inviting me with the documented invite link instead.

report.discloseBody: This goes straight to the Pavisie developer, not to any other server. Included: exactly what you type in the next step (subject and body), plus this server's id and name, your user id and tag, the current time, and the bot's version. Nothing else is sent — no surrounding messages, channel history, or member list. A record is also written to this server's own audit log so other admins can see a report was sent.
report.success: Sent to the Pavisie developer. Thanks for the report!
